notes.title: Carmen Sandiego 🌈Pride FestiVILE🌈
notes.content:
The party’s just getting started in New Orleans, until VILE crashes the celebration, stealing the float decorations for the city’s biggest pride parade! With time running out, it’s up to Carmen to save the day (again). Join FestiVILE, a limited-time event bursting with color, chaos, and classic VILE mischief, running until July 6! Complete the mission to unlock a fabulous new in-game outfit, fit for a master thief with serious pride. 🌈

[previewyoutube=mqHPsr2QTrk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]✨ New Content[/h2]


[list]
[*][h3]FestiVILE (Limited-Time Event)[/h3]
[list]
[*]Detectives, keep an eye on the Secrets to Discover icon in The ACME Files… If a city suddenly feels a little more 🌈colorful🌈 than usual, you’re on the right track. 

[*][b]FestiVILE Unlockable Outfit[/b] – Complete the Pride FestiVILE to earn a limited-time Pride-themed costume. Once you’ve unlocked it, it’s yours to keep!
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*][h3]Community Reward [/h3]
[list]
[*]All players receive the [b]Beachwear outfit[/b] as a thank-you gift from the Wishlist Community Challenge. (Thanks, gumshoes!)
[/list]
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192987/cc77e86221f345a5593682ff20ffb757e88b9d3c.jpg[/img]

[h2]🛠️ Patch Notes[/h2]


[list]
[*][h3]FestiVILE Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added Auto Collect for fact gathering.

[*]New reminder pop-ups help players stay on track during the event.
[/list]

[*][h3]Identikit Tutorial Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]First-time players are now guided more clearly when setting their first clue.

[*]Clue-related tabs now flash and highlight if clues are missing, to help players stay on course.
[/list]

[*][h3]Grapple Puzzle Tutorial Update[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a clear prompt to assist new players in their first puzzle

[/list]
[/list]

For more information and to sign up for updates, visit www.carmensandiego-game.com and join the conversation on our social channels:

Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/theofficialcarmensandiego/]@theofficialcarmensandiego[/url]

notes.title: 🌸 FestiVILE: The Hanami Heist Begins!
notes.content:
VILE has disrupted Japan’s Cherry Blossom Festival, boldly stealing the sacred shinboku tree in broad daylight! Join FestiVILE, a limited-time event running until May 4, and help the world’s greatest thief track down the culprits before the season ends.

🎶 By popular demand, we’ve also added an iconic track to the in-game soundtrack, the Carmen Sandiego Theme Song by Sean Altman and David Yazbek is now live!

[previewyoutube=zWGH3kGnaGs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]✨ New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Hanami FestiVILE[/h3] (Limited-Time Event)
[list]
[*] Detectives, keep an eye on the Secrets to Discover icon in The ACME Files… If a city suddenly feels a little more festive than usual, maybe with petals in the air, you’re on the right track. 🌸
[*] This season’s FestiVILE takes place in Ueno Park, Tokyo, right in the middle of the Sakura Matsuri, that’s the Cherry Blossom Festival! 
[*] Stroll through the festivities, chat with locals, and keep your eyes peeled. VILE’s left clues scattered among the crowds,
[*] Not all clues bloom at the festival itself! Be sure to return to the ACME Files between missions, there may be more secrets hiding in plain sight.
[*] New Outfit: Complete the Hanami FestiVILE to permanently unlock Carmen’s Happi outfit in-game!
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192987/4e07624637a14ef87dc55b90396cafa62489026c.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [h3]You Know the Words...[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Carmen Sandiego Theme Song (ROCK Mix) — “Where In The World Is Carmen Sandiego?” — is now in the game!
[*] 🎵 Words & music by Sean Altman (Big Sean Music, BMI) and David Yazbek (Yeidlesounds, BMI).
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192987/2056837a07dfbf7a264b3b2b0ae45493eaf1b164.jpg[/img]
[h2]🛠️ Patch Notes[/h2]
[list][*] [h3]Caper Restart Option[/h3]
[list][*] Made a wrong accusation? You can now restart from the last city instead of starting over entirely [/list][/list]
[list][*] [h3]Identikit Enhancements[/h3]
[list][*] Incorrect clues now trigger a warning. Sections with errors will be highlighted for clarity.[/list][/list]
[list][*][h3] UI Tweaks for Investigation Tools[/h3]
[list][*] The Recon button turns yellow when multiple suspects remain.
[*] The Warrant button turns yellow only when one suspect remains. [/list] [/list]
[list][*][h3] Grapple Tutorial Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Miss two attempts in a row or stay inactive for 10 seconds? The tutorial will now activate to assist.
[/list][/list]

For more information and to sign up for updates, visit www.carmensandiego-game.com and join the conversation on our social channels:

Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/theofficialcarmensandiego/]@theofficialcarmensandiego[/url]

X (Twitter): [url=https://x.com/CarmenSandiego]@carmensandiego[/url]

Facebook:[url=https://www.facebook.com/carmensandiego] Carmen Sandiego[/url]

Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/carmensandiego ]https://discord.gg/carmensandiego [/url]

notes.title: Community Challenge Update: 25K Wishlists & 500 Discord Members!
notes.content:
Gumshoes, you’ve done it again! Thanks to your incredible support, we’ve hit 25,000 Wishlists AND achieved our first Discord community milestone of 500 members!

[h3]Unlocked Rewards 🎉[/h3]

✅ Steam Avatars – A set of Carmen Sandiego-themed avatars will be available for the community!
✅ 10% Deluxe Edition Discount on Launch – Steam players will now receive a launch discount on the Deluxe Edition.

Keep the Chase Going!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192987/2b289fd5711198c83f8d78e244695343d919238e.jpg[/img]

We’ve introduced a brand-new Discord Community Challenge, where more milestones mean more exclusive rewards for early members:

🔓 1.5K Members: Team Red Wallpaper

🔓 5K Members: Game Team Q&A Video

And on the wishlist front, we’re getting closer to the next big reward:

🎉 65K Wishlists: In-game global festivals 🌸 will be introduced in future updates + a 15% Deluxe Edition discount on launch!

This is just the beginning, let’s keep the momentum going! 🕵️‍♀️🔎

notes.content:
We hit 10K Wishlists! Thanks to your support, the Team VILE Device Wallpaper is now available for download.

Get them below!

[h2]HOW IT WORKS[/h2]

We’ve set wishlist milestones for Carmen Sandiego. Each milestone comes with exclusive rewards for the community, adding even more excitement to the journey ahead.

By adding the game to your wishlist, you’ll help us hit these goals and unlock the rewards for everyone to enjoy when the game launches. Every wishlist counts—let’s hit these milestones together!

 

MILESTONE GOALS
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192987/0d1cee6ce6aed3b4643325e8c27d9e9e2a644e81.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [strike]10,000 Wishlists: Unlock official Carmen Sandiego wallpapers for the community! [/strike]✅
[*] 25,000 Wishlists: Unlock Carmen Sandiego-themed Steam avatars + a 10% deluxe edition discount on launch.
[*] 65,000 Wishlists: Celebrate global festivals in-game like the Sakura Festival and Dia de los Muertos + a 15% deluxe edition discount on launch.
[*] 100,000 Wishlists: Unlock a new Casual Carmen skin + a 20% deluxe edition discount on launch.
[/list]
 

[h3]Important Notes[/h3]

Festivals Update: Global festivals will be introduced in timed future updates, adding vibrant cultural events to the game.

Bonus Carmen Skin: This in game cosmetic will be unlocked for all players during the first major game update—no extra steps required!

 

[h2]HOW TO PARTICIPATE[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Add Carmen Sandiego to your Steam wishlist.
[*] Spread the word! Share the news with friends and fellow fans to help us hit those milestones.
[*] Keep an eye on our social channels for updates on our progress and new announcements.
[/olist]

Are you ready to join the chase? Wishlist now and help us unlock amazing rewards!

For more information and updates, visit Carmen Sandiego Official Website and follow us on:

Instagram: @theofficialcarmensandiego
Twitter: @carmensandiego
Facebook: Carmen Sandiego
